QuestInfo.name: [Game of Yut] Stuck in a Yut
QuestInfo.0: #bAn exciting game of Yut#k is going to take place in the Maple World during Springtime. You should give it a shot!
QuestInfo.1: You need the Yut Stick Set to play a #bgame of Yut#k.
QuestInfo.2: You can play a game of Yut by clicking on the notifier on the left. Hunt monsters to find Yut Sticks and win prizes in the #bMaple Game of Yut#k!
